card.name: Inside all-caps warning headings
card.fires_on: The middle or end of a long word written in capital letters, mostly the O in EMBRYO of the boxed-warning heading EMBRYO-FETAL TOXICITY. It also fires on the ends of other capitalized words in headings.

modes.label: EMBRYO in boxed warning
modes.description: The letter O completing EMBRY in the all-caps heading EMBRYO-FETAL TOXICITY.

modes.label: Other capitalized heading words
modes.description: The last piece of other long capitalized words in headings, such as TRANSFUSION or WATERSHEDS.
